hints: Work along the digits, counting the readings of each prefix. How can a reading of the first `i` digits end?
With a one-digit letter or a two-digit one - so the count at `i` is the count at `i-1` plus the count at `i-2`, with each term allowed only when its letter is legal.
A one-digit letter is legal when the digit is not `0`. A two-digit one is legal when the pair reads between 10 and 26.
That is the stairs recurrence with two conditions attached, and the zeroes are what make the conditions matter.
